name: savematerials-simple
description: Simple rung for the saveMaterials flag (IXT-SUITES batch 6): tier:'simple', default-on 'Name + Save' row inside MaterialComposer (nested under the already-covered materialComposer flag, mirroring the suggestions-inside-designScore pattern from batch 4). Opens the composer, asserts the Save row is present (hidden when force-disabled, restored after), types a custom name, applies the composed finish then Saves it, and asserts a SavedMaterial with that exact name lands in state.savedMaterials.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).
